subject: Math
skill: Evaluating Statistical Claims Observational Studies And Experiments
prompt: A biology teacher designed and conducted a study to determine whether using a certain note-taking technique improves high school students' retention of biology vocabulary. For the study, the teacher chose a random sample of $48$ students from all of the students at one of the high schools in a county. The teacher found that students who used the technique showed significant improvement in vocabulary retention. What is the largest group to which the results of the study can be generalized?

choices.B: All students at the high school
choices.C: All high school students in the county

explanation: Choice B is correct. The largest group to which the results of a study can be generalized is the population from which the random sample was chosen. In this case, the teacher chose a random sample from all students at one particular high school. Therefore, the largest group to which the results can be generalized is all the students at the high school.
